description: Saves a copy of a roster to the signed-in player's account: one of their own from list_my_rosters, or a public or unlisted one they can open. variant true keeps the copy grouped with the original as an alternative version, which only works on their own rosters; false makes a standalone copy. The copy takes the player's default visibility, which is public unless they changed it, whatever the original's. Returns the new roster's id, url and visibility: tell the player when it is public, and offer set_roster_visibility. Requires mcp:write.

variant.description: Group the copy with the original as a variant; only for the player’s own rosters.

name: copy_roster
title: Copy a roster
